sounds.name: music_parchment

sounds.event: parchment music: SAME tune for intro and ending; loops (JUMP C1A8) until replaced
sounds.cpc_equivalent: CPC music START (intro) and END (ending) -- the CPC has two different tunes

sounds.name: music_background
sounds.trigger: 0x1f97 at game start (0x553), and 0x608a every main-loop pass when no phrase is on the scroll ([B85E]==0) via 0x6367 -> 0x543 (start only if the engine is idle)
sounds.event: in-game background tune; loops forever (JUMP C45F); any effect cuts it and it restarts from the top
sounds.cpc_equivalent: CPC 0x1007 'inicia un sonido en el canal 1' (CPC 41AB, same routine)
sounds.mapping_confidence: high (site); tune itself has no CPC twin checked

sounds.name: get
sounds.trigger: 0x53e5: object mask changed and new bit set -> 0x637c

sounds.name: speech
sounds.trigger: 0x53a2 (phrase put on the scroll) and 0x2cc5 (20x with a delay when the demo's key buffer runs out)
sounds.cpc_equivalent: CPC 0x1020 'canal 3' (CPC 3B73 per phrase character, 320B demo end x20)

silent_on_dos.where: 0x1f20/0x1faf via 0x63a3 -> 0x543: silences the speaker if idle
